More Information
Is Neurobion Forte suitable for vegetarians or vegans?
According to the Indian product label, each tablet of Neurobion Forte contains Cyanocobalamin Triturate in Gelatin which is equivalent to Cyanocobalamin IP 15mcg.
Gelatin, which is used in the tablet’s formulation, is usually derived from animal sources, including bones, hides, and pork skin, as it is obtained by hydrolysing treated animal collagen. Therefore, due to inclusion of gelatin, neurobion forte may be considered not suitable for use in strict vegans.
However, vegetarians who consume dairy products and eggs may find it acceptable, as they typically include animal-derived sources of Vitamin B12 in their diets.
Diet Tips for Supporting Nerve Health:

A balanced diet rich in essential nutrients is crucial for maintaining healthy nerves and overall health. Here are some diet tips to support nerve health:

B Vitamins:
Include foods rich in Vitamin B1 (Thiamine), B2 (Riboflavin), B6 (Pyridoxine), and B12 (Cyanocobalamin), such as whole grains, legumes, leafy greens, eggs, and dairy products. These vitamins are essential for nerve function, reducing the risk of neuropathy and nerve damage.
Vitamin B12 is particularly important for maintaining the protective myelin sheath around nerves, and can be found in animal products like fish, meat, and dairy. For vegetarians and vegans, consider fortified foods or supplements.
Omega-3 Fatty Acids:
Foods rich in Omega-3 fatty acids, such as fish (salmon, mackerel), chia seeds, flaxseeds, and walnuts, support nerve health by reducing inflammation and promoting repair.
Antioxidant-Rich Foods:
Incorporate antioxidant-rich fruits and vegetables like berries, leafy greens, and bell peppers to reduce oxidative stress that can damage nerve cells.
Turmeric and ginger are also excellent for reducing inflammation and supporting nerve recovery.
Magnesium-Rich Foods:
Foods like spinach, almonds, avocado, and bananas are rich in magnesium, which helps relax muscles, prevent spasms, and promote overall nerve health.
Exercise and Stress Management for Nerve Health

Exercise and stress management are key components for supporting nerve health and alleviating nerve pain. Consider these tips:

Stretching Exercises:
Gentle stretches help maintain flexibility and reduce nerve tension. Focus on stretches for the neck, back, and legs, as these areas often experience nerve pain.
Sciatic nerve stretches or nerve gliding exercises can specifically target nerve discomfort in the lower back and legs.
Yoga for Nerve Health:
Yoga poses like Child’s Pose, Downward Dog, and Cobra Pose help relax the nervous system and stretch tight muscles that may be pressing on nerves.
Breathing exercises (Pranayama) can lower stress levels and enhance nerve repair by increasing oxygen flow to tissues.
Regular Physical Activity:
Low-impact exercises like walking, swimming, and cycling help increase blood circulation, support nerve regeneration, and reduce inflammation. Regular movement prevents nerve compression and helps in overall stress management.
Mindfulness and Relaxation Techniques:
Practices like meditation, deep breathing, and progressive muscle relaxation can reduce stress, which in turn alleviates nerve pain caused by tension and anxiety.
Healthy Habits to Correct Vitamin Deficiencies:

To prevent vitamin B deficiencies and promote nerve health, consider these healthy habits:

Balanced Diet:
Focus on a diet that includes a variety of nutrient-rich foods. Ensure you consume a wide range of B vitamins (B1, B2, B6, B12) through whole grains, lean meats, legumes, eggs, and dairy.
For vegetarians or vegans, consume fortified foods or consider B12 supplements to meet daily requirements.
Regular Check-Ups:
Visit your healthcare provider regularly to monitor vitamin levels, especially if you experience symptoms of deficiency, such as fatigue, numbness, or tingling sensations.
Supplements:
If your diet is lacking in specific vitamins (like B12), your doctor may recommend supplements. Always follow the recommended dosage and consult your healthcare provider to avoid over-supplementation, which can cause side effects.
Hydration and Sleep:
Drink plenty of water to maintain optimal nerve function and stay hydrated.
Aim for 7-9 hours of quality sleep each night to help your body repair nerve tissues and restore energy levels.
Avoid Excessive Alcohol and Smoking:
Chronic alcohol consumption and smoking can impair nutrient absorption, particularly B vitamins. Limit alcohol intake and quit smoking to support nerve health.

By combining a nutritious diet, regular exercise, and healthy lifestyle habits, you can effectively prevent vitamin deficiencies, alleviate nerve pain, and support overall nerve health.

introduction:
Introduction About PYRICONTIN TABLET

PYRICONTIN TABLET is a combination of Folic Acid (Vitamin B9) and Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6) which belongs to the group of medicines called B Vitamins. It is used to manage anaemia caused due to lack of vitamins (folate-based megaloblastic anaemia) or pregnancy (to manage neural tube defects in babies Ex. spina bifida) or surgical removal of the stomach (gastrectomy).

It is also used to manage anaemia caused by chronic red cell breakdown (haemolytic states) or kidney dialysis, Pellagra (vitamin B deficiency), idiopathic sideroblastic anaemia (a condition in which the red cells in the blood do not form properly) and adjunctively (in combination with other medicines) to manage vitamin 12 deficiency (pernicious anaemia).

The symptoms of vitamin B deficiency include inflammation of the skin (dermatitis) and tongue, diarrhoea, disorientation, depression and confusion. PYRICONTIN TABLET additionally manages sprue, a disease in which food cannot be absorbed by the gut, along with damage to the nerves (peripheral neuritis) caused by isoniazid (a drug used to manage tuberculosis).

PYRICONTIN TABLET must be taken in consultation with your doctor when used in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children below 12 years of age. It is generally safe to use PYRICONTIN TABLET and rarely patients can experience loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting or upset stomach. Consult your doctor if you experience any of it after taking it.

Introduction About B LONG F TABLET

B LONG F TABLET is a combination of Folic Acid (Vitamin B9) and Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6) which belongs to the group of medicines called B Vitamins. It is used to manage anaemia caused due to lack of vitamins (folate-based megaloblastic anaemia) or pregnancy (to manage neural tube defects in babies Ex. spina bifida) or surgical removal of the stomach (gastrectomy).

It is also used to manage anaemia caused by chronic red cell breakdown (haemolytic states) or kidney dialysis, Pellagra (vitamin B deficiency), idiopathic sideroblastic anaemia (a condition in which the red cells in the blood do not form properly) and adjunctively (in combination with other medicines) to manage vitamin 12 deficiency (pernicious anaemia).

The symptoms of vitamin B deficiency include inflammation of the skin (dermatitis) and tongue, diarrhoea, disorientation, depression and confusion. B LONG F TABLET additionally manages sprue, a disease in which food cannot be absorbed by the gut, along with damage to the nerves (peripheral neuritis) caused by isoniazid (a drug used to manage tuberculosis).

B LONG F TABLET must be taken in consultation with your doctor when used in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children below 12 years of age. It is generally safe to use B LONG F TABLET and rarely patients can experience loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting or upset stomach. Consult your doctor if you experience any of it after taking it.

Introduction About MECOBEL OD TABLET

Mecobel-OD Tablet is a nutritional supplement used to manage peripheral neuropathy (weakness, numbness and pain from nerve damage usually in the hands and feet) and megaloblastic anaemia caused by vitamin B12 deficiency. It contains methylcobalamin (vitamin B12) as an active ingredient for managing peripheral neuropathies and megaloblastic anaemia.

Methylcobalamin helps in the transmethylation reaction, which speeds up the metabolism of proteins, lipids and nucleic acids. As a result, it has a healing impact on damaged nerve tissues. In those with neuropathies, it has an inhibiting effect on nerve degeneration. Also, it helps the body to make healthy red blood cells and nerve cells.

Always take Mecobel-OD Tablet as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not take this medicine if you are allergic to any of its components.

The regular supplemental doses of vitamin B6 don’t report any side effects while taking large daily doses may result in developing a condition called peripheral neuropathy (pins and needles pain in body extremities). Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

Introduction About ME 12 FORTE INJECTION

ME 12 FORTE INJECTION contains Methylcobalamin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. ME 12 FORTE INJECTION is used to manage diabetic neuropathy (nerve damage caused by diabetes), peripheral neuropathy (peripheral nerve damage that affects hands, feet, and arms), and megaloblastic anaemia (blood disorder) caused by vitamin B12 deficiency in affected individuals.

ME 12 FORTE INJECTION is also used to manage sciatica pain (leg pain), back pain, and general weakness in affected individuals.

ME 12 FORTE INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin and/or other B12-containing medicines.

Before receiving ME 12 FORTE INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have Leber's disease (an inherited form of vision loss) and/or are suffering from low potassium levels (with associated signs such as muscle twitches/cramps, low blood pressure), optic nerve disease (swelling and nerve damage to the eyes), and kidney and/or liver problems.

ME 12 FORTE INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 months to 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving ME 12 FORTE INJECTION are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite, skin rash, and/or hot flushes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Introduction About RE XITE INJECTION

RE XITE INJECTION contains Methylcobalamin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. RE XITE INJECTION is used to manage diabetic neuropathy (nerve damage caused by diabetes), peripheral neuropathy (peripheral nerve damage that affects hands, feet, and arms), and megaloblastic anaemia (blood disorder) caused by vitamin B12 deficiency in affected individuals.

RE XITE INJECTION is also used to manage sciatica pain (leg pain), back pain, and general weakness in affected individuals.

RE XITE INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin and/or other B12-containing medicines.

Before receiving RE XITE INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have Leber's disease (an inherited form of vision loss) and/or are suffering from low potassium levels (with associated signs such as muscle twitches/cramps, low blood pressure), optic nerve disease (swelling and nerve damage to the eyes), and kidney and/or liver problems.

RE XITE INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 months to 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving RE XITE INJECTION are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite, skin rash, and/or hot flushes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

RHINOCOBAL 250MCG NASAL SPRAY contains Mecobalamin which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. RHINOCOBAL 250MCG NASAL SPRAY is also used to manage adult patients with vitamin B12 deficiency that occurred due to dietary, drug-induced, and/or malabsorption factors. It is also indicated for use to manage vitamin B12 deficiency in adult patients with vitamin B12 requirements.

RHINOCOBAL 250MCG NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin, cobalt, and/or vitamin B12. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from severe Leber hereditary optic neuropathy (inherited form of vision loss), and/or runny nose/nasal blockage.

It is also used with caution in breastfeeding women and children & adolescents (aged below 18 years).  The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of using RHINOCOBAL 250MCG NASAL SPRAY are headache, weakness, inflamed/swollen tongue, burning/prickling sensation in arms/legs, nausea, and/or stuffy nose. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About B 29 TABLET

B-29 is a nutritional supplement used in adults and elderly to manage nutritional deficiencies in conditions like diabetic neuropathy (nerve damage occurring over time because of high sugar and fat levels in the blood due to diabetes).

B-29 contains various vitamins and trace elements that helps to reactivate damaged neurons and overcome nutritional deficiencies.

Methylcobalamin and Folic acid takes part in the production of myelin (compound which covers and protect nerve fibres), thus restores the damaged nerve cell, improves the functional recovery of nerves, speed of nerve conduction, and cell multiplication.

Alpha lipoic acid is an antioxidant that reduces oxidative stress, which is considered as a main pathophysiology of diabetic neuropathy development.

Vitamin B6 is essential for human nutrition and aids in a variety of metabolic transformations, and Vitamin D3 promotes the active absorption of calcium and phosphorus by the small intestine, thus helps permit bone mineralization.

Take B-29 exactly as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water after meals. Do not take B-29 if you are diagnosed with increased calcium or vitamin D levels in blood or malabsorption syndrome.

B-29 should be used with caution in patients with kidney or heart problems. Ask your doctor before giving this medicine to pregnant women, breastfeeding women or children.

introduction:
Introduction About MEAXON 500MCG INJECTION

MEAXON 500MCG INJECTION contains Methylcobalamin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. MEAXON 500MCG INJECTION is used to manage diabetic neuropathy (nerve damage caused by diabetes), peripheral neuropathy (peripheral nerve damage that affects hands, feet, and arms), and megaloblastic anaemia (blood disorder) caused by vitamin B12 deficiency in affected individuals.

MEAXON 500MCG INJECTION is also used to manage sciatica pain (leg pain), back pain, and general weakness in affected individuals.

MEAXON 500MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin and/or other B12-containing medicines.

Before receiving MEAXON 500MCG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have Leber's disease (an inherited form of vision loss) and/or are suffering from low potassium levels (with associated signs such as muscle twitches/cramps, low blood pressure), optic nerve disease (swelling and nerve damage to the eyes), and kidney and/or liver problems.

MEAXON 500MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 months to 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving MEAXON 500MCG INJECTION are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite, skin rash, and/or hot flushes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Introduction About GENOPLEX CZS TABLET

Genoplex Czs Tablet is a nutritional supplement used to reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease by reducing homocysteine levels in individuals with high blood pressure. It contains Multivitamins, Selenium, Chromium, and Zinc as active ingredients that helps to boost immune health, improve cardiac health.

Pyridoxine, nicotinamide, cyanocobalamin, and folic acid works by lowering the levels of homocysteine (a type of protein) in the blood and reduce the risk of heart disease. Chromium improves insulin sensitivity. Selenium is rich with antioxidants and helps to protect the cells against oxidative damage. Zinc is essential for normal immune function.

Always take Genoplex Czs Tablet exactly as advised by your doctor. Swallow Genoplex Czs Tablet with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the tablet. Inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing conditions before taking Genoplex Czs Tablet.
